measurement_scope: Separate ingest, direct Python analyze function, and verify operations. Not the complete analyze/report commands, report rendering, report validation, or public export.

caveats: One local measurement, not a benchmark distribution or a cross-tool comparison.
Filesystem cache was not flushed. Verify follows ingest and analysis.
Sparse synthetic records do not represent all real formats, corrupt data, high correlation density or live acquisition.
Peak RSS is per-process high-water memory, not incremental allocation or total system memory.
Input generation and interpreter startup are excluded from phase wall times.
A failed phase's elapsed time is time until refusal or failure, not successful throughput.
Case size is logical file bytes, not allocated filesystem blocks. Temporary input and case are deleted after the run.

filesystem.cache: not flushed; later phases may use warm filesystem cache

environment.process_model: Each measured phase runs in a new child process; peak RSS includes that process's imports and retained case state.
environment.wall_time_scope: Case open/create, operation and case close; interpreter startup and input generation are excluded.

implementation.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 over sorted relative Python source paths and bytes, each followed by NUL

input.description: Six authentication failures, one success and one process record per sparse group; other records are generic. All data is synthetic.
